title: coord.py wait on an item's progress returns at each non-final move (working, landing), so a wait for a landing wakes the orchestrator once per intermediate state
goal: coord.py wait takes a --state option that returns only on a move to one of the listed states, so one wait serves a landing or a worker's return
repro_reason: the missing option shows only in the help text; planting a store needs the coord internals

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;st=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite');c=lambda *a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py',*a,'--store',st],capture_output=True,text=True);[c('post','--kind','progress','--field','item=BG-aaaaaaaa','--field','state='+s) for s in ('working','landing','landed')];r=c('wait','--since','0','--timeout','0','--kind','progress','--item','BG-aaaaaaaa','--state','landed,refused');print(r.returncode,r.stdout[-300:],r.stderr[-200:]);ev=json.loads(r.stdout)['events'] if r.returncode==0 else [];sys.exit(0 if [e['fields']['state'] for e in ev]==['landed'] else 1)
